description: Diversinet Java Crypto Module is a JCA (Java Cryptography Architecture) Provider shipped with Diversinet MobiSecure Products. The Crypto Module implements several JCE (Java Cryptography Extension) algorithms including Triple DES, AES, SHA, HMAC, DRBG and RSA. The Crypto Module is packaged in a signed Java Archive (JAR) file.
